responsibility: Implements out-of-line behavior for Rust HIR nodes and traversal support. It provides stringification helpers such as as_string methods, indentation/debug formatting utilities, and the concrete accept_vis visitor dispatch methods for many HIR classes, keeping bulky virtual and clone-adjacent code out of the headers. This compilation unit is the shared runtime support layer for the HIR tree representation itself rather than AST lowering.
same_name_distinction: Provides out-of-line behavior for the HIR tree definitions from rust-hir.h, such as as_string formatting helpers and accept_vis visitor dispatch methods, rather than declaring the HIR data model itself.
